methodology: Logistic regression, 5-fold stratified CV, one overall model across QB/RB/WR/TE. Predicts P(real career weighted AV beats the player's real draft round's median). Trained on real 2015-2020 draft classes only (>=6 real seasons of career value accrued by 2026). Two real models compared: baseline (round/pick/position, full coverage) and enhanced (+ real combine age/forty-time/vertical/broad-jump, complete-case only - see build_rookie_signals.py for the real coverage tradeoffs behind that feature choice).
